keys.empty.title: No API keys yet
keys.empty.description: A key lets your apps and tools call models. Create one to get started.
keys.quota.unlimitedHint: This key has no spending cap. Calls are still charged to your account balance (or subscription quota).
keys.group.followUserHint: Uses the group your account belongs to
keys.group.priceRatioHint: Billed at {{ratio}}× the standard price in this group
keys.ccSwitch.description: CC Switch is a desktop tool that writes the Base URL and key into Claude Code, Codex or Gemini CLI. Install it first.
keys.form.createDescription: A name is all you need. You can change the other settings later.
keys.form.updateDescription: Change this key's name, expiry, spending cap and restrictions.
keys.form.quotaLimitHint: When off, the key has no cap and calls are charged to your account balance.
keys.form.quotaAmountHint: The key stops working once the cap is used up. You can raise it any time.
keys.form.advancedDescriptionCreate: Group, model limits, IP allowlist, bulk creation
keys.form.groupHint: Groups can differ in available models and price. Leave empty to follow your user group.
keys.form.crossGroupRetryHint: If a call fails in the current group, try the next group in order.
keys.form.quantityHint: Creates several keys at once; from the second key on, names get a random suffix.
keys.created.title: Key created
keys.created.description: Put the key and Base URL into your app to start calling models.
keys.created.keyHint: Treat the key like a password. You can copy it again from the list later.
keys.created.keyUnavailable: The key was created, but it can't be shown here. Use the copy button in the list to get it.
keys.created.baseUrlHint: OpenAI-compatible; works with most apps and SDKs. Claude Code and Cherry Studio use the site address: {{root}}
keys.created.oneClickHint: Requires the matching app (CC Switch or a chat app) installed on your computer.
keys.chat.externalTitle: Open it from the key menu
keys.chat.externalDescription: {{name}} opens in an external app. Go to API Keys and choose One-click setup → Chat apps in a key's menu.
